content.text: The only MFN-type provision runs in our favour. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The sole most-favoured-nation provision (§ 7.6) is granted by Vendor in our favour: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. Nothing in the fee provisions (§ 7), Order Form terms (§ 4), or General (§ 30) obliges Customer to extend best terms to Vendor or to match third-party offers, and there is no exclusivity or right-of-first-refusal construct that operates as a customer-side MFN. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer, Vendor-granted MFN welcome), so no redline is proposed.
